fresh_wwii_queries.query: SELECT DISTINCT ?item WHERE { { ?item wdt:P607/wdt:P361* wd:Q362 } UNION { ?item wdt:P1344/wdt:P361* wd:Q362 } UNION { ?item wdt:P361+ wd:Q362 } UNION { ?item wdt:P921 wd:Q362 } }

limitations: Article links plus lexical phrase extraction and exact bilingual label/alias lookup are not guaranteed exhaustive; no trained NER or matching model is used. Homonymous unlinked phrases can add unrelated provisional QIDs.
Fresh WWII population is defined by the saved explicit-statement query, not every semantically WWII-related entity.
Trigram scores are similarities, not correctness probabilities; equal-highest QID ties use saved-seed random selection.
Type categories use the saved broad root policy; MISC is a residual known category.
Synthetic IDs identify mentions, not verified new real-world entities.
